title: Understanding Mini-batch Gradient Descent
text: Mini-batch gradient descent is a compromise between stochastic gradient descent and batch gradient descent. It updates the model parameters more frequently than batch gradient descent but less frequently than stochastic gradient descent.

title: Behavior of Mini-batch Gradient Descent
text: In mini-batch gradient descent, the updates to the parameters can sometimes overshoot the optimal value, causing the parameters to oscillate around the optimal solution.

title: Identifying the Correct Gradient Descent Type
